## Summary

Briefly describe what this PR changes and why.

## Related issue

Link the tracking issue (e.g. `Closes #123` or `Refs #123`).

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactor (no functional change)
- [ ] Documentation / CI / build
- [ ] Breaking change

## Test evidence

- [ ] `./mvnw test` passes locally
- [ ] New/updated unit tests added
- [ ] New/updated integration tests added (`*Tests`)
- [ ] Manual verification performed (screenshots / curl samples attached)

## Checklist

- [ ] Follows `.editorconfig` (UTF-8, LF, 2-space indent, max 120 chars)
- [ ] Conventional commit message (`feat`, `fix`, `chore`, ...)
- [ ] Public APIs annotated with Spring Modulith stereotypes
- [ ] Docs / wiki updated if behavior changes
- [ ] ADR added for architectural decisions
